text: Claudeville 3, attempt 1: goal 100,000 people by 2050 on Medium ($10,000), disasters on, flat map. Plan: one big road grid east of the river, coal power, river pumps, then grow dense.
Main avenue x=76 to the north map edge, 4 streets (y=21,28,35,42).
Homes y22-27, shops y36-38, factories y43-45 (factories farthest from homes).
Coal plant (200 MW, $4,000) next to the factories, power line along x=101 to every zone.
4 water pumps by the river and pipes under every zone row.
Empty zones don't carry power: added power lines x=84 and x=92 through all zones, linked to the plant along y=46.
Water pumps had no power: ran a power line from the zones to the pumps along y=20.
More power lines through the zones (x=80, 88, 96) so every block gets power faster.
Road link to the neighbor city at the north edge ($1,000) to bring outside trade for shops and factories.
Tax 7% -> 3%: income is only ~$58 a year at this size, so low taxes to boost growth matter more.
Water fell to 48%: added 2 pumps at the east lake and 2 more by the river (water back to 99%).
Took a $10,000 bond at 5% ($500/yr interest). Income is only ~$57/yr at this size, so borrowing is the only way to keep building.
More factory land (y39-41) because 38% of people had no job; new homes y29-34.
New factory district south: streets y=49 and y=56, factory rows y47-55, power lines and pipes.
10 more river pumps (x=73, y28-37) after water slipped to 67%.
North housing district: streets y=6 and y=13, home rows y3-16 (x77-92), power lines and pipes.
Far east blocks were ~60 road tiles from jobs (only one north-south road). Added connector roads x=88 (middle) and x=102 (east).
Second $10,000 bond (4%) and tax 3% -> 6%: the coal plant is maxed out and water is at 24%.
Second coal plant (x106-109) and 7 more river pumps.
East district: streets y=21/28/35 to a new avenue x=125, dense homes y22-34 (x103-124), power lines and pipes.
Dense shops y37-41 in the east (shop demand has been maxed for years), street y=42 extended to x=124.
Factory rows y57-62 with street y=63 (factory demand maxed, 17% unemployed). Cash now nearly zero.
Third $10,000 bond (4%). Yearly bond payments now about $1,300 vs ~$700 tax income: growth has to pay for this.
Fire station (x103-105, y36-38) and police station (x77-79, y17-19).
Second neighbor link: street y=28 to the east map edge ($1,000).
More factory rows y64-69 with street y=70, pipes for the south factories.
7 water pumps on the east lake (x108-114, y19).
Newspaper: 'Claudeville 3 Drying Up' - real water shortage (the game's own water graph was 0-19%). Added 25 pumps right on the riverbank.
Fourth bond. Third neighbor link: street y=56 east to the map edge, right next to the south factories (test: are factories failing because trade trips are too long?).
Test: homes y71-76 right next to the never-built factory rows y64-69.
Attempt 1 ended in Jan 2022 at 9,190 people (needed ~44,000 on pace). Post-mortem written; attempt 2 starts with a compact layout.
